# `del_list`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Delete a named object list and all objects in it.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcd080, ObjListConfig::DelList @0x6c3360 (64-bit build) |

Finds the list by display name and removes its whole subtree from the persistent object-list configuration.

Side effects: Removes a list entry and its objects from the persistent XML configuration, synchronously. No event is emitted by the handler.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"del_list"`. [READ] |
| `params` | string\|array | no | - | The list display name, as a bare string or as a one-element array whose first element is used (extra elements ignored). Absent, null, empty array or a non-string gives 105. No length check. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | params is absent, null, an empty array, or not a string | `expected string param` |
| 236 | The configuration root or the named list is not found | `xml item is not found` |
| 234 | Lower RemoveChild step: configuration file name storage is empty | `xml file name is empty` |
| 229 | Lower RemoveChild step: the XML key could not be opened | `fail to open xml key` |
| 230 | Lower RemoveChild step: the XML item could not be deleted | `fail to delete xml item` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Lower-level codes 234, 229 and 230 are established for the 64-bit RemoveChild only; 32-bit equivalence is not asserted. Close and save outcomes are not returned as RPC errors; other lower failures are unresolved.

## Example

Request, delete:

```json
{"id":41,"method":"del_list","params":"Winter targets"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"del_list","result":0,"code":0,"id":41}
```

Reply, not-found:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"del_list","error":"xml item is not found","code":236,"id":42}
```
